newsitem.title: FRANCE: INSTANT VIEW - French Unemployment down 12,000.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - French Unemployment down 12,000.

text.p: Following are analysts' comments on the 12,000 drop in French unemployment in October, leaving the unemployment rate unchanged at 12.6 percent, the Labour Ministry reported.

Well I don't think they (the figures) are telling us much about the trend. We have to view them in perserpective. Unemployment rose close to 70,000 over the previous two months and here I think we're seeing the usual volatility, probably paybacks for the strong rises of the past months.

It hasn't changed that much as the rate's still high, but it's clearly better than expected. I was quite encouraged by the figure. It's not going to make a big difference but it does give the government a bit more breathing space.

It's more month to month volatility. I really don't thing it signals a change in the overall deterioration although I would have expected unemployment to have risen. The only thing that gives pause has been slight improvements in consumer expectations about the future level of unemployment.
The six month moving average is still a rise of 15,000 so this is contradictory to the trend.
